summary: PASS 1 grind (2026-08-04): Settings went from nav-only (15 of 17 visible pages showing only the generic placeholder) to fully built. Header chrome (gear icon + 'Settings' title, prose font) now matches; the CONNECTION/AGENTS/TELEMETRY/APP rail groups render (MasterDetail gained group-header support). Every backed page now renders real content sourced from actual GET calls (providers/models/commands/prompts/agentBlueprints/expertPacks/mcpServers/hooks/policies/memoryStats/metrics/health/capabilities) or genuine client state (the connection registry, wire/plugins.ts, wire/settings-export.ts, theme.ts preferences) -- Settings.tsx now takes a real `client` prop threaded from SessionView instead of rendering with none. Plugins and Data & backups were reclassified from 'unbacked' to 'client': both had complete, working modules (wire/plugins.ts, wire/settings-export.ts) that were simply never wired to a nav entry -- that was a stale claim, not a real gap. The 'Agents' nav item's true backing was corrected from client.agents() (the expert/agent-blueprint CATALOG -- confirmed wrong by SessionView's own comment distinguishing it from 'connected clio deployments') to the same live-connection data Backends uses. Only Relays remains genuinely unbacked (ships hidden, per #337's established pattern) -- no relay registry route exists on either side. Several pages honestly diverge from a literal prototype-text copy where doing otherwise would misrepresent a real, working backend (Memory would have to claim a live cache subsystem 'reports no memory capability'; Models' 'router lm' role does not exist in the wire) -- those are called out per-item below and are NOT silently omitted.
